final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS ob, e.fillcount AS fc FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), g AS (SELECT ob, AVG(fc) AS avgfill, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY ob), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.ob, g.avgfill, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL
